operations.name: parties.create-party
operations.description: Create a person or organization atomically with explicit IDs, typed details, optional contact channels and business identifiers. No IDs are generated. Raw strings are limited to 512 UTF-16 units each and 4096 total, including whitespace and repeated IDs. PartyId, ContactChannelId, IdentifierId and removal ID entries have a tighter 128-character limit; business identifier Value strings use the 512 limit. Null collections or items reject; omitted lists default to empty. Sub-operation count is 1 plus every ContactChannels and Identifiers item; the configured cap defaults to 100.

operations.name: parties.deactivate-party
operations.description: Soft-deactivate an existing party without erasing personal data. Processing must be unrestricted and the current erasure status must be Active. An already inactive party is unchanged only after these checks.

operations.name: parties.reactivate-party
operations.description: Reactivate an existing inactive party. Processing must be unrestricted and the current erasure status must be Active. An already active party is unchanged only after these checks.

operations.name: parties.update-party
operations.description: Atomically replace details for the existing party type; add, update or remove contact channels; add or remove business identifiers. Party type cannot change. Supply at least one supported change; activation is separate. Raw strings are limited to 512 UTF-16 units each and 4096 total, including whitespace and repeated IDs. PartyId, ContactChannelId, IdentifierId and removal ID entries have a tighter 128-character limit; business identifier Value strings use the 512 limit. Null collections or items reject; omitted lists default to empty. Sub-operation count is each non-null PersonDetails or OrganizationDetails object plus every item across the five operation lists; the configured cap defaults to 100.
